chunks: Abu Sulayman Ahmad ibn Hawtha al-Bahili narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq an-Nahawandi narrated to us from Nahawand in the year 273 AH, saying: Abu Muhammad Abdullah ibn Hammad al-Ansari narrated to us in the year 229 AH, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir al-Ju'fi, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) about al-Sufyani, and he said: 'How can you have al-Sufyani until al-Shaysabani rises before him? He will rise from the land of Kufa, flowing forth like water flows forth, and he will kill your delegation. So anticipate after that al-Sufyani, and the rising of al-Qa'im (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.أَرْضِ كُوفَانَ: The land of Kufa, a city in Iraq with significant eschatological importance.
key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: Al-Sufyani, a prominent eschatological figure in Shia tradition associated with the pre-Mahdi era.
key_terms.الشَّيْصَبَانِيُّ: Al-Shaysabani, a figure who rises before al-Sufyani from Kufa.
key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: Al-Qa'im, referring to Imam al-Mahdi (peace be upon him), the awaited leader.
key_terms.يَنْبَعُ: He flows forth/emerges, describing the manner of his rise.

ai.seo_question: What is the sequence of the rise of al-Shaysabani and al-Sufyani according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Nu'mani's *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Baqir clarifies the eschatological sequence by establishing al-Shaysabani as a precursor to al-Sufyani, emerging rapidly from Kufa to eliminate the Shia delegation. This specific ordering underscores the Shia scholarly tradition of distinguishing between the chaotic pre-Qa'im conflicts and the ultimate rise of the Mahdi, providing believers with a chronological framework for recognizing the signs of the end times.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (8) Abu Sulayman Ahmad bin Hawtha narrated from Ibraheem bin Iss’haq an-Nahawandi from Abu Muhammad Abdullah bin Hammad al-Ansari from Amr bin Shimr that Jabir al-Ju’fi had said:

“Once I asked Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) about as-Sufyani and he said: “As-Sufyani does not rise until ash-Shaysabani rises before him. He (ash-Shaysabani) will rise from Kufa. He will flow like water. He will kill your delegation. After that you expect the rising of as-Sufyani and then al-Qa’im (as).”
